howItWorks.title: How does the tool work?
howItWorks.subtitle: In just a few seconds, suggestions tailored to your moment.
howItWorks.step1Text: Tell us where you are, or let the tool locate you automatically. Choose your radius, your budget, your group. In thirty seconds, everything is set.
howItWorks.step2Text: The tool doesn't just return a raw list. It calculates what truly matches your current situation, taking into account opening hours, your budget and your preferences.
howItWorks.step3Text: Parks, museums, escape rooms, spas, hiking trails, restaurants, water sports centres, workshops, thousands of activities near you, including those that never show up in the usual search results.

seoContent.title: Finding activities near you: why is it always so complicated?
seoContent.p1: There's a paradox that many people experience without ever putting it into words. They've lived somewhere for years, they know their city and its surroundings, and yet when the question comes up, "what shall we do this weekend?", the answer is always the same. The same restaurant. The same cinema. The same walk.
seoContent.p2: It's not laziness. It's an information problem. Your area is full of activities you've never tried, simply because nothing ever pointed them out to you at the right time, with the right criteria.
seoContent.quote: Most of the activities that exist around you don't advertise. They're there, you just didn't know where to look.
seoContent.card1Title: The everyday activities right on your doorstep
seoContent.card1Text:
Before we talk about hidden gems, there are classics that we underestimate because we think they're too ordinary. A well-frequented park on a Sunday morning. The local swimming pool on a scorching day. A marked hiking trail you've never done despite fifteen years in the same town.

A library that hosts exhibitions, a local market you've never really taken the time to explore. These activities are free or nearly so, accessible on foot, and they've been there all along.

Our tool lists them all, and it often turns out that the most relevant result isn't the escape room at 30 euros per person, but the forest viewpoint twelve minutes away by bike that you'd never noticed on a map.
seoContent.card2Title: Couple activities: breaking out of autopilot
seoContent.card2Text:
Couples fall into the same routine often faster than they realise. The Friday restaurant, the Saturday film, the Sunday sofa. Not because that's what they truly want, but because finding something else takes a research effort that nobody feels like making after a busy week.

An afternoon at a wine cellar fifteen kilometres away. A shared pottery class. A kayak trip on the nearest river. A visit to a castle you've driven past a hundred times without ever stopping.

These activities don't require much time or much money. They just require knowing they exist, and being willing to try them once.
seoContent.card3Title: Family activities: the "something for everyone" puzzle
seoContent.card3Text:
With children, the filter narrows considerably. Not too long, not too expensive, doable for a five-year-old, pushchair-accessible if needed, not too far, open on Sundays, and ideally something the parents also find at least somewhat interesting.

The good news: these activities exist, there are plenty of them, and they go well beyond the same theme park you revisit every year. Educational farms, swimming lakes, forest parks with junior tree-top adventures, interactive museums, local zoos that are often far less crowded than national parks.

Our tool filters by children's age, which genuinely changes the suggestions: an activity perfect for a ten-year-old may be completely unsuitable for a two-year-old.
seoContent.card4Title: Free activities: they're there, often invisible
seoContent.card4Text:
We tend to think that going out costs money. That's true for some activities. But a significant portion of what surrounds you is entirely free, and not just boring either.

Marked hiking trails through landscapes you don't know. Botanical gardens at the edge of your town. Markets with real character. Viewpoints over valleys that even locals haven't all discovered. River beaches accessible by bike.

Our tool filters by budget starting from "free", and the results in this category often hold genuine surprises.

filtersInfo.title: Filters designed for your situation
filtersInfo.subtitle: Because what works on a Saturday evening as a couple doesn't work on a Sunday with the family.
filtersInfo.f1Text: Automatic geolocation or manual entry. Radius from 1 to 5 km. Travel mode: walking, cycling, driving, public transport.
filtersInfo.f2Text: Solo, couple, family with children, friends, team building. If you have children, enter their age, it genuinely changes the suggestions.
filtersInfo.f3Text: From free to over 50 euros per person. The tool estimates the price of each activity and filters accordingly, with an adjustable tolerance.
filtersInfo.f4Text: Calm and relaxing, fun and festive, cultural, adrenaline, romantic, family-friendly. This filter adjusts the ranking far more effectively than a simple category filter.
filtersInfo.f5Text: Less than an hour, one to two hours, half a day, full day. The tool excludes activities that don't fit your time slot, without you having to check yourself.

ctaFinal.title: Ready to discover what's waiting for you?
ctaFinal.text: Most people who use this tool for the first time come away with at least one surprise, a place they didn't know about that matches exactly what they were looking for without knowing how to put it into words. Enter your location, choose your filters, and let the tool do the rest.
